build_flow_model: build a Flow Model with flow_dim and output_dim parameters for flow-based generation
run_forward_generation: run a forward pass on the Flow model with noise tensor and integration steps
train_flow_model: train the Flow model using the learn method with an output tensor to compute MSE loss
run_flow_step: run a single ODE integration step of the Flow model with x_t, t_start, and t_end
run_flow_encoder: run the Flow model encoder by concatenating x_t and t through the LinearEncoder
